name: Femboy Wants To Be Mayor
source:
Gather Your Crew, Win the Election! This isn’t just a battle of ballots; it’s a fight for freedom. Stand against Valeria’s corrupt system alongside your loyal team.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4511700/Femboy_Wants_To_Be_Mayor/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
集结你的团队，赢下这场大选！这绝非仅仅是一场选票之争，更是一场为自由而战的较量。与你忠心耿耿的伙伴们并肩携手，挺身反抗瓦莱里娅腐败的统治体制吧。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4511700/Femboy_Wants_To_Be_Mayor/]Steam[/url]]
